title: My account
twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
twofa.explain: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app. You will be asked for it at every login.
twofa.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the first code it shows.
twofa.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twofa.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key by hand:
twofa.backupExplain: Keep them somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
twofa.disableExplain: To turn it off, confirm with your password and a code (from the app, or a backup code).
keys.title: API keys
keys.explain: Let a script or another tool use Armadok with only the rights you choose. A key can never do more than you can.
keys.createdExplain: Copy it now: it is shown only once and cannot be read again.
keys.name: Name (what it is used for)
keys.noRights: You hold no right that a key can carry.
keys.sensitiveNote: Sensitive rights (managing rights, resetting passwords) are never available to keys. Choosing a right also chooses what it needs.
